lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 closed the round-1 WARNING at plan-escalation.ts:89: the positive read path of exhaustedBudget was untested. test/supervisor/plan/plan-escalation.test.ts now has three new cases: a round-trip with exhaustedBudget: 'auditor', a round-trip with exhaustedBudget: 'oracle-lint', and the adversarial case where an on-disk 'bogus' value is dropped by the shape guard rather than trusted (readPlanEscalatedMarker's exact behavior at plan-escalation.ts:89-91). While running the full bun test / check:all gates for this story, a pre-existing flake surfaced in test/integration/orch-respawn-reresolve.test.ts (added in US-003/CAM-425): its two real-subprocess tests use spawnSync with an internal 15_000ms timeout but had no per-test bun:test timeout override, so they rode bun's un-raisable 5000ms default and could fail under check:all's CPU contention even though they pass in isolation (same CAM-201 flake class documented in patterns.md). Per gate discipline (no-flaky-evasion), fixed at the root rather than dismissed: added { timeout: 20_000 } as the third arg to both test(...) calls. This is unrelated to exhaustedBudget but was required to get a green check:all for this story; the next agent does not need to revisit either file. US-R1-002 (priority 2, already in prd.json) is the next queued round-1 fix: stale doc comments describing the escalation contract (events.ts:494/:72, plan-runner.ts:248/:1472/:1523/:2161, plan-escalation.ts:6/:23, sidecar.ts:2396) still describe the pre-US-002/US-003 single-budget behavior and need a mechanical sweep to reflect the oracle-lint/auditor budget split. Two SUGGESTIONs (non-blocking, not separately filed as US-R1 stories) remain in prd.json's review.findings for future consideration: (1) plan-runner.ts:1448's PlanEscalationWriterParams inherits exhaustedBudget as optional from Omit<PlanEscalatedMarker,'writtenAt'>, which the reviewer suggests tightening to required at the writer seam; (2) plan-runner-replan.test.ts:366's planner-spawn bound assertion only covers the all-lint-blocked case, not an interleaved lint+auditor+lint run where the summed MAX_LINT_REPLAN_ROUNDS+MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS bound is actually load-bearing.
